raw: {"mode":"iff","restated":"∃ Γ Λ : CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}, Group.FG Γ ∧ Group.FG Λ ∧ (Infinite Γ ∧ ∀ g : Γ, g ≠ 1 → Set.Infinite {h : Γ | ∃ x : Γ, h = x * g * x⁻¹}) ∧ HasKazhdanPropertyT Γ ∧ (Infinite Λ ∧ ∀ g : Λ, g ≠ 1 → Set.Infinite {h : Λ | ∃ x : Λ, h = x * g * x⁻¹}) ∧ HasKazhdanPropertyT Λ ∧ Nonempty (TracialGroupFactorEquiv Γ Λ) ∧ ¬ Nonempty (Γ ≃* Λ)","proof":"exact Iff.rfl","english":"There exist two finitely generated countable discrete groups Γ and Λ, both infinite with every non-identity element having an infinite conjugacy class (ICC), both with Kazhdan's property (T), such that there is a normal, trace-preserving *-isomorphism between their group von Neumann algebras, yet there is no group isomorphism Γ ≃* Λ.","why_clearer":"It spells out the ICC condition as infinite conjugacy classes, and states the factor isomorphism and group non-isomorphism directly as the existence or non-existence of the relevant equivalences, instead of through the bespoke wrapper definitions IsICC, TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic and GroupsIsomorphic."}

parsed.restated: ∃ Γ Λ : CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}, Group.FG Γ ∧ Group.FG Λ ∧ (Infinite Γ ∧ ∀ g : Γ, g ≠ 1 → Set.Infinite {h : Γ | ∃ x : Γ, h = x * g * x⁻¹}) ∧ HasKazhdanPropertyT Γ ∧ (Infinite Λ ∧ ∀ g : Λ, g ≠ 1 → Set.Infinite {h : Λ | ∃ x : Λ, h = x * g * x⁻¹}) ∧ HasKazhdanPropertyT Λ ∧ Nonempty (TracialGroupFactorEquiv Γ Λ) ∧ ¬ Nonempty (Γ ≃* Λ)
parsed.english: There exist two finitely generated countable discrete groups Γ and Λ, both infinite with every non-identity element having an infinite conjugacy class (ICC), both with Kazhdan's property (T), such that there is a normal, trace-preserving *-isomorphism between their group von Neumann algebras, yet there is no group isomorphism Γ ≃* Λ.
parsed.why_clearer: It spells out the ICC condition as infinite conjugacy classes, and states the factor isomorphism and group non-isomorphism directly as the existence or non-existence of the relevant equivalences, instead of through the bespoke wrapper definitions IsICC, TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic and GroupsIsomorphic.
